title: New .6 magnitude earthquake hits the municipality of Istmina
subtitle: The seismic tremor occurred on the night of Friday, August 21, 2026, at a shallow depth.
excerpt: A 2.6 magnitude earthquake was recorded on August 21, 2026, in the municipality of Istmina, according to official monitoring data.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On August 22, 2026, the Explosão Solar portal brings information about a seismic tremor recorded on the night of Friday, August 21, 2026. The tremor had a magnitude of 2.6 and a shallow depth.

Details of the seismic event

The municipality of Istmina was the epicenter of the tectonic movement. Monitoring systems recorded the event at 21:41 local time on Friday, August 21, 2026. The earthquake was also felt in neighboring towns.

Support and official channels

Authorities maintain open channels for assistance and data collection. The population that perceived the movement in the region can report the fact through official platforms. The system relies on sensor networks to detect tremors and analyze location and magnitude data.

How to set up earthquake alerts

  • Open your phone's settings.
  • Tap Safety and emergency and then Earthquake alerts.
  • If you cannot find Safety and emergency, tap Location and then Advanced to select Earthquake alerts.

Family emergency plan

It is recommended that families implement a prevention plan that includes the creation of an evacuation route and the identification of safe locations. The emergency kit should contain water, a flashlight, a radio, non-perishable food, and identification documents.

Actions during and after the earthquake

During the event, stay calm and take cover in structurally safe areas, such as under a desk or near a column, avoiding doors, windows, or elements that could detach. After the tremor, act with caution, avoid elevators, and assess structural damage before re-entering buildings.

With information from El Tiempo.
